# Build a matrix as described in the following paper \[10.13140/RG.2.2.19275.55840\](10.13140/RG.2.2.19275.55840)

Build a matrix as described in the following paper
\[10.13140/RG.2.2.19275.55840\](10.13140/RG.2.2.19275.55840)

## Usage

``` r
build_stacked_matrix(D, V, js, D1, V1, js1 = 0)
```

## Arguments

- D:

  Deviation for small counts

- V:

  Variance for small counts

- js:

  js for small counts

- D1:

  Deviation for last count

- V1:

  Variance for last count

- js1:

  js for last count

## Value

ptable object

## References

Jamme J (2026). “Why not a little bit of bias? In the search of
improving the risk-utility trade-off while releasing frequency tables
protected with the cell key method.” In *the 12th European Conference on
Quality in Official Statistics*.
[doi:10.13140/RG.2.2.19275.55840](https://doi.org/10.13140/RG.2.2.19275.55840)
.

## Examples

``` r
build_stacked_matrix(15, 20, 5, 15, 5, 0)
```
